items.title: Edgar "Sambo" Joseph Interview, 1960-08-07
items.q: My pet, Shauna. Oh, my pet. Yeah, my pet used to call him.

ctx.x: What did they call him again?

They used to call him a pet. My pet, Shauna. Oh, my pet. Yeah, my pet used to call him. What do you get, a little pitch of wine? He'd sit on the side of us and go in there, all right, boys. Get there, get your horn together, take your man, take your knee. Why the jerk, you know, make the straight leg like that, you know? Oh, yeah. You tell people like this, it sounds funny. Oh, all right. And so, you sit down there by him. You come there wrong, you know what he tell you? Go back home.
And you didn't get to blow your horn at all? No, you didn't blow no horn right away.
